title: Template -- Scheduled Task created by a scripting host
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin canonical templates
description: Canonical sigma detection template for MITRE ATT&CK T1053.005 (Scheduled Task). Scheduled tasks are one of the most-used persistence mechanisms precisely because creating one is a normal administrative act -- so the signal is not the task, it is who created it. This template scopes to schtasks.exe invoked with /create by a scripting or living-off-the-land parent (PowerShell, cmd, wscript, mshta, rundll32), which is the shape a script-delivered implant takes and not the shape a deployment tool or an admin at a console takes. Synthetic exemplar from the WinstonRedGuard threat-intel corpus -- no actor binding; review and bind to your environment before deployment.
